build.script: pkill -x AmigaGuide 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -x 'Amiga Guide' 2>/dev/null || true; xcodebuild -project AmigaGuide.xcodeproj -scheme AmigaGuide -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build-sandbox ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=YES CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS=AmigaGuide/AmigaGuide.entitlements SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS='DEBUG' build && open "build-sandbox/Build/Products/Debug/Amiga Guide.app"

run.script: pkill -x AmigaGuide 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -x 'Amiga Guide' 2>/dev/null || true; xcodebuild -project AmigaGuide.xcodeproj -scheme AmigaGuide -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath build ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=NO CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS='' SWIFT_ACTIVE_COMPILATION_CONDITIONS='DEBUG' build && open "build/Build/Products/Debug/Amiga Guide.app"
